Bhajagovindastotra
or Mohamudgara or Dvādaśapañjarikāstotra [Page001-a. by Śaṅkarācārya. The moral an. ethical principles of life are given in simple language; additions are said to have been made by his disciples numbering fourteen; hence known a. Caturdaśapañjarikā (has the refrain bhaja govindaM bhaja govindaM govindaM bhaja mUDhamate).
See under Caturdaśapañjarikāstotra an. also under Dvādaśapañjarikā stotra.
